mapper.select: select p.plan_id as planId, p.plan_name as planName, p.site_name as siteName, p.main_platform_name as mainPlatformName, p.status, count(r.record_id) as recordCount, max(r.inspection_time) as lastSampleTime from sup_auto_inspection_plan p left join sup_auto_inspection_record r on r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.source_type = 'AUTO' and r.inspection_time >= #{beginTime} and r.inspection_time < #{endTime} group by p.plan_id, p.plan_name, p.site_name, p.main_platform_name, p.status order by lastSampleTime desc, p.plan_id desc

select tr.result_id as resultId, tr.record_id as recordId, r.inspection_time as sampleTime, sr.step_id as stepId, sr.step_name as stepName, sr.tool_code as toolCode, sr.tool_name as toolName, tr.target_id as targetId, tr.target_name as targetName, tr.target_type as targetType, tr.actual_value as actualValue, tr.actual_unit as actualUnit, tr.previous_value as previousValue, tr.change_value as changeValue, tr.result_status as resultStatus, tr.evaluation_mode as evaluationMode, tr.evaluation_rule as evaluationRule, tr.baseline_flag as baselineFlag, tr.comparison_scope as comparisonScope, tr.window_key as windowKey from sup_auto_inspection_record r inner join sup_auto_inspection_target_result tr on tr.record_id = r.record_id left join sup_auto_inspection_step_result sr on sr.step_result_id = tr.step_result_id where r.plan_id = #{planId} and r.source_type = 'AUTO' and r.inspection_time >= #{beginTime} and r.inspection_time < #{endTime} order by r.inspection_time desc, tr.result_id desc limit #{limit}

select r.record_id as recordId, r.inspection_time as sampleTime, r.duration_ms as durationMs, r.result_status as resultStatus from sup_auto_inspection_record r where r.plan_id = #{planId} and r.source_type = 'AUTO' and r.inspection_time >= #{beginTime} and r.inspection_time < #{endTime} order by r.inspection_time desc, r.record_id desc limit #{limit}
